propositions: CodeHealthConfig.analyzers field is never read outside config plumbing; the per-language analyzer dispatch was intentionally designed empty and never wired
resolve_analyzer, analyze_or_unavailable, and load_lizard functions are dead code with zero production callers
The dispatch seam was never viable: analyze_or_unavailable calls analyzer.analyze(languages=languages) by keyword but scc_loc.analyze expects scan_roots parameter, causing TypeError

AnalyzerResult protocol and Analyzer interface must be retained as documentation; the live composition path in git_metrics.py (_scc_analysis, _lizard_analysis, _jscpd_analysis, _cached_analysis, _structural_spec) is the working implementation that must not change
Removal requires a tombstone registry entry for config_health.analyzers and env var REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ANALYZERS to prevent silent configuration drops
Test count decreases by 5 (two dispatch tests, two load_lizard guard tests, one analyzers case) with no coverage loss; rebar metrics output for structural metrics remains unchanged
